## Purpose and availability
IBM's support index lists distinct data, warehouse, process and service model offerings. These are a family of assets, not one interchangeable cross-industry model.

The index includes Banking and Financial Markets Data Warehouse, Insurance Information Warehouse, Unified Data Model for Healthcare and Data Model for Energy and Utilities. Historical Retail Data Warehouse entries include end-of-support dates.

## Licensing and dependencies
Public support documentation does not establish an open model licence. Exact rights, acquisition terms, modelling tools and product entitlements were not verified. Do not redistribute commercial model files based on the public index.

## Version boundary
The support page lists historical releases, including 8.10.1 for banking and insurance warehouse offerings. This is not a claim that those are the latest supported releases. Confirm the selected offering's current status and tooling before use.

## Evidence
No customer outcome or comparative implementation result was assessed. Vendor promises about acceleration are not accepted as measured results.

## Official source
[Getting started with IBM Industry Models](https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/getting-started-ibm-industry-models-2), Offerings and release/support tables; checked 2026-10-19. Publication date not established in inspected content.
